summary: This stylesheet defines styles for a feedback or rating component with a container, question text, action buttons, and a thank-you message section. It uses flexbox for layout, CSS variables for theming, and includes hover effects on buttons that smoothly transition between states.

explanations.4: flex-wrap: wrap allows items to break onto multiple lines if they don't fit in one row, instead of shrinking to fit.
explanations.5: gap: 0.75rem adds consistent spacing between flex items — in this case, roughly 12 pixels of space between elements.
explanations.16: white-space: nowrap prevents the question text from breaking into multiple lines, keeping it as a single line.
explanations.26: inline-flex makes the button behave like an inline element but with flexbox layout powers, so it only takes up as much width as its content needs.
explanations.36: transition defines which properties will smoothly animate over 0.15 seconds when they change, making color changes feel less jarring.
explanations.42: This is a pseudo-class selector that applies styles when someone hovers their mouse over a .btn element.
explanations.48: .btnNeutral:hover is a more specific version of the button hover rule that applies only to buttons with the btnNeutral class, overriding the primary button colors.
explanations.70: color: var(--ifm-color-content-secondary) uses a CSS variable for a muted text color, making secondary information visually distinct from primary content.
